calls.reason: The evidence is mixed. Chu et al. report RL transfer to held-out rules, and Song et al. report OOD rule learning, but neither rules out pretraining overlap. Chen et al. document memorization failures, which shows the problem exists but not that it is all LLMs do.

No study in the packet compares current AI with attentive humans at telling satire or fiction from fact. The satire-classification paper is older and possibly contaminated, and the humor paper measures joke explanation, not that distinction.

The Tow Center found uncritical source handling, which fits the concern but cannot prove 'never'. The Yao et al. study reports some correct assessments of fabricated news, but its test timing and whether the material was unfamiliar are unverified, so the categorical claim stays unsettled.
